field_types.Price: Wire value: string or number. Parsed value: Decimal; blank or missing is null; non-finite or non-numeric fails the field.
field_types.StreamPrice: Wire value: string or number. Parsed value: as `Price`, and the stream sentinel `42949672.95` (ATO, no price) is null.
field_types.Volume: Wire value: string or number. Parsed value: Decimal (volumes and open interest can exceed 32 bits); parsed like `Price`.
field_types.Quantity: Wire value: string or number. Parsed value: int; integral decimals such as `10.00` are accepted, fractions and booleans fail the field; blank is null.
field_types.EpochTime: Wire value: epoch seconds (string or number). Parsed value: timezone-aware UTC datetime; `0` or blank is null.
field_types.ISTDateTime: Wire value: text in one of `%H:%M:%S %d-%m-%Y`, `%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S`, `%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S`, `%d-%m-%Y`, `%d-%b-%Y`. Parsed value: datetime at +05:30; an unknown format is null (logged once per shape, never the value).
field_types.str: Wire value: string or number. Parsed value: string (JSON numbers become strings).
field_types.enum X: Wire value: string. Parsed value: member of `X`, or the original string when unknown.
field_types.secret str: Wire value: string. Parsed value: masked in `repr` and logs.

types.Decimal: Exact decimal number (never a binary float): prices, money and volumes.
types.float: Binary floating-point number; never NaN or infinite (non-finite is null).
types.object: A JSON object kept as parsed: keys and values are untyped.
types.TradeSmartError: The SDK's error type (`TradeSmartError` and its subclasses).

enum_rules.wire_enums: Lookups trim the input and compare case-insensitively against the wire value and the accepted words. Response fields typed `enum X` keep an unknown value as the original string; request parameters reject it (`RequestValidationError`) before sending.
enum_rules.value_enums: Returned by the SDK, never sent to the server: the values are exact (case-sensitive) and there are no accepted words. They print as their value.

record_notes.note: Floats are never NaN or infinite: a non-finite value is null.
Quantities are in trade units on every exchange, MCX included (whole multiples of the lot size).

Derived from the row's `oco_first`, `oco_second` and `oco_triggers`; it has no wire keys and no `raw`. The side is decided by `alert_type` (`OCO_BUY`: the leg with the higher trigger is the stop-loss; `OCO_SELL`: the lower one), never by the leg's slot or `trantype`.

leniency.required: The field must be present (a missing required field fails the record).
leniency.lenient: In a lenient record a top-level field that fails validation becomes null and the original value stays in `raw`.
leniency.protected: A protected key (`norenordno` and `status`; `al_id` on `Gtt` and `TriggeredGtt`) failing fails the whole record (`ResponseParseError`, or `UnknownMessage` on the stream).
leniency.unknown_keys: Unknown wire keys are kept (`extra` fields) on every model.

models.name: AccessToken
models.description: Result of `GenAcsTok`. Token values are masked in `repr`/`str`/`raw`.

models.name: ProductInfo
models.description: One enabled product with the exchanges it is available on.

models.name: HoldingInstrument
models.description: One exchange listing (`exch_tsym` element) of a holding.

models.name: OrderHistoryEntry
models.description: One state transition of `SingleOrdHist` (an `Order` plus history-only fields).

models.name: OcoTrigger
models.description: One trigger value of an OCO row of `GetPendingGTTOrder` / `GetTrgOi` (an item of `oivariable`): `var_name` `x` or `y` names the leg it belongs to.

models.name: OcoLegRow
models.description: One order leg of an OCO row (`place_order_params` / `place_order_params_leg2`). Its trigger value is not here: it is the `oivariable` item with the same slot (`x` for the first leg, `y` for the second), see `Gtt.oco_triggers`. Other keys of the leg (`s_prdt_ali`, `C`, `ipaddr`) are kept as extras.

models.name: TriggeredGtt
models.description: One triggered GTT of `GetTrgOi` (its order was sent; see `Order.parent_id`).

models.name: Quote
models.description: Result of `GetQuotes` (flat snapshot incl. five depth levels).

models.name: StreamMessage
models.description: Base of every inbound stream message; `t` is the task type.

models.name: UnknownMessage
models.description: A message that is not valid JSON, has an unknown `t`, or failed validation.

records.name: OptionGreeks
records.description: `option_greeks()` result: the Greeks plus every input used, so it can be explained.

records.name: ChainRow
records.description: One option contract of a chain snapshot.

records.name: OptionChainSnapshot
records.description: Quotes for a set of option contracts taken at `fetched_at`.

records.name: MaxPain
records.description: Max-pain strike and the total payout to option buyers at each candidate strike.

records.name: BuildupReading
records.description: A buildup classification with the changes it was derived from.

records.name: SlicedOrderResult
records.description: `place_sliced_order()` result: the planned slices and what was placed.

records.name: OcoSide
records.description: One side of an OCO row, the result of `Gtt.stop_loss` / `Gtt.target`: the leg and its trigger value. A derived, read-only result (not a wire model).
